Heritage Haveli — Boutique Wedding Venue, Jodhpur

Heritage Haveli is a restored boutique haveli in Jodhpur offering an intimate,
character-rich setting for small weddings — courtyards, frescoed halls, and
rooftop spaces with fort views. Capacity is modest (~250 guests), suited to
intimate celebrations.

The full-haveli buyout is ₹5,50,000 per day, including heritage rooms for up to
40 guests and basic traditional decor. Catering can be in-house or approved
outside vendors.

Contact: +91 91610 33442 · stay@heritagehaveli.example
Location: Old City, Jodhpur, Rajasthan
Rating: 4.8 / 5 (87 reviews)

What couples say:

Heritage Haveli specializes in intimate weddings and offers a curated heritage
experience, with the wedding party often staying on-property for the duration.
